goal: Compile or package coding-session artifacts into governed WASM-compatible capsules when a language/runtime supports it.

phases.description: Run languages through local governed host runners and emit receipts.
Add clang/wasmtime lanes for C/C++ and Rust wasm32-wasi outputs.
Package HTML/CSS/JS/TypeScript frontends into previewable static capsules.
Add Pyodide/MicroPython, TeaVM, TinyGo, and Octave-compatible host bridge support.
Convert receipts into GitHub commits, release assets, local deploys, and governed publication lanes.
